verdict.rationale: Coinbase ships an official CDP SDK, published on GitHub as client libraries for EVM and Solana wallets. The docs say developers can use it for x402 payments and for treasury and payout flows ("with the CDP CLI or SDK"). Missing for 10: the supported languages are not documented, there is no SDK API reference showing how deeply it covers payments features, and there is no independent or hands-on confirmation of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Client libraries for managing EVM and Solana wallets while relying on CDP to secure private keys.
Charge for your endpoints with x402 and the CDP SDK.
Accept customer USDC, auto-convert it to USD, and collect it in your treasury, with the CDP CLI or SDK.
Fund a USD treasury and pay out USDC onchain to any wallet, with the CDP CLI or SDK.
